correctness.rationale: A permutation with exactly n-2 fixed points is one transposition: its span d=b-a removes exactly d records, hence w_n(r,n-2)=r. Exactly n-3 fixed points entails one three-cycle; counting the two orientations by their outer span gives w_n(r,n-3)=(2r-1)n-2r^2. Algebraic cancellation yields adjacent minor 2r(r+1)-n; r=1 makes 4-n<0 for all n>=5. Full TP2 for n=2,3,4 is established by complete exact joint matrices and all minors. For the covariance identity, condition record I_i on each fixed-point J_j: j<i contributes 1/(i-1), j=i contributes 1/binom(n-1,i-1), and j>i contributes 1/i, causing cancellation and giving positive (1/n)sum_{j=1}^{n-1}binom(n-1,j)^-1. Independently enumerated all n! permutations for n=2..8 and tested the covariance and near-identity cells exactly.
